import json
from pathlib import Path
p=json.loads(Path('.ai/task/batch-e9fa145f873dd1bfdf43/SURFACE-SCREEN-ENVELOPE-lane-000-3.json').read_text())
e=p['payload']['entries']
r=[]
for i,x in enumerate(e):
    y={'entry_revision_identity':x['entry_revision_identity'],'verdict':'OK'}
    if i==16:
        assert x['source'].count('\n')==1 and x['target'].count('\n')==0
        y.update(verdict='ISSUE',observation='原文在两句之间有换行，译文遗漏该换行。')
    r.append(y)
out={'candidate_identity':p['candidate_identity'],'contract':'translation_surface_screen_v1','results':r}
s=json.dumps(out,ensure_ascii=False,sort_keys=True,separators=(',',':'))
d=json.loads(s)
assert len(e)==len(d['results'])==20
assert len({x['entry_revision_identity'] for x in d['results']})==20
for x,y in zip(e,d['results']):
    assert x['entry_revision_identity']==y['entry_revision_identity'] and len(y['entry_revision_identity'])==64
print(s,end='')
